entities.name: Robert Kuwałek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Kuwałek was a Polish historian, noted for his work on the history of the Jewish community in the Lublin area and on the Holocaust. He worked at the Majdanek State Museum. 2004–2007 he directed the Museum in Belzec, a new branch of Majdanek State Museum.
